subject: Next steps: 30-minute demo & stakeholder availability
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Nicola Grant <nicola.grant@cerebrohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: 30-minute demo & stakeholder availability

Hi Nicola,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery: Cerebro is evaluating inference platforms to reduce per-request latency for clinical search and to gain tighter cost controls across batch and realtime workloads. Key constraints you called out were HIPAA-aligned private deployment options, predictable SLOs for peak hours, and a migration path that preserves existing prompt-engineering investments.

Suggested next step: a focused 30-minute product demo that walks through: 1) how we route by policy and fallback to model variants, 2) a short live run showing end-to-end latency/cost numbers on a representative query set, and 3) discussion on private deployment options (VPC/KMS).

I pulled three time options that align to the stakeholders you mentioned on the call. Please let me know which works best, or propose alternatives:

- Option A: Tue Aug 24, 10:00–10:30 AM PT (Rishi, Marissa, Jasmine)
- Option B: Wed Aug 25, 2:00–2:30 PM PT (Rishi, Jasmine)
- Option C: Thu Aug 26, 9:00–9:30 AM PT (Rishi, Marissa)

If you can share which of your stakeholders will attend (and their roles), we’ll tailor the short agenda so it’s relevant. Attaching a one-page demo agenda and a draft mutual action plan.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf, Cerebro-MAP-v1.xlsx

Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-minute demo & stakeholder availability

Hi Rishi,

Appreciate the summary — that matches our priorities. Option B (Wed Aug 25, 2:00 PM PT) works best for us. I’m looping in James (Head of Data Platforms) and Maya (Security/Compliance lead) to join the session so they can evaluate the private deployment/KMS bits.

For context on attendees:
- James Collins — will focus on integration points and throughput needs.
- Maya Singh — will be looking for encryption at rest/in transit details, audit logs, and SOC2 evidence.

If you can include a short run of a sample query against a cached prefix (to show latency improvement) that would be ideal. We’d like to keep this to 30 minutes.

Nicola
